name: Cannith Boots of Propulsion
binding_raw: Bound to Account on Acquire , Exclusive
upgradeable: Catalyst Crafting to Demonic Rush Legendary Demonic Rush

effects.name: Striding
effects.tooltip: Striding +30% : This item makes you more fleet of foot, giving you a 30% Enhancement bonus your movement speed.

effects.name: Feather Falling
effects.tooltip: Feather Falling : This item is engraved with feathers and bestows a powerful magical effect. Whenever the wearer begins to fall from any height, this effect slows the descent dramatically, causing the wearer to fall like a feather.

effects.name: Jet Propulsion
effects.tooltip: Jet Propulsion : Use this item to activate the air elemental bound within, thus propelling you forward at great speeds. It takes ten minutes to recharge between uses. 1 use per 10 minutes (equivalent to Abundant Step / Leap of Faith / Wind Dance )

effects.name: Jump
effects.tooltip: Jump +10 : Passive: +10 Competence bonus to the Jump skill.

effects.name: Enhanced Jump
effects.tooltip: Enhanced Jump +5 : Passive: +5 Enhancement bonus to the Jump skill.

flavor_text: Footwear manufactured by House Cannith. Marvels of technology, these boots cause their wearer to run faster and fall more slowly. They can even provide a powerful boost to propel the wearer through the air, though it takes a while for them to recharge.
tips: On elite, there are up to 7 chests boots can drop from: Dackle 's chest, and up to six chests in the final room before the boss fight (four static, one optional for each lieutenant dealt with through dialog). The three chests after defeating the boss do not drop boots.

source.detail: Dackle's chest some end chests (hard or elite difficulty only)
source.raw: Schemes of the Enemy , Dackle's chest, some end chests (hard or elite difficulty only)
